name: Cnucha

attributes.attribute: obscure Irish heroine who nursed Conn of the Hundred Battles
father who buried Cnucha near Dublin
place named in honor of the buried heroine

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Cnucha was an Irish heroine or goddess. This little known figure nursed Conn of the Hundred Battles when he was young. She died of a fever. Her father, Connad, buried her in the land near Dublin in the spot later named Castleknock in her honor.

okr.objective: Cnucha is a little known heroine who nursed Conn and gave a place its name.
key_results: Cnucha nursed Conn of the Hundred Battles.
She died of a fever and was buried near Dublin.
Castleknock was named in her honor.
